issues.on_page: Keno Fund revenues 1,188 (p29; KENO column of 'Loan repayments and other', p24); General Fund Lot sales 12,208, Rural fire 2,000, Other park 2,930 (p16-17)
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-21: split remainder into keno/lottery 1,188, charges for services/fees 17,138 and other 39,054] The computed remainder of Miscellaneous revenue (p6) includes Keno Fund receipts of 1,188, which have their own category (keno/lottery; the detail already records them that way, detail[164]). It also includes 17,138 of General Fund charges for services (lot sales, rural fire, other park) that the detail files under charges for services. The printed breakdowns make these splits possible, so filing them under 'other' breaks the same-label-same-category rule. Only Other revenues 29,953, Street Other 6,471 and CDBG loan repayments 2,630 (39,054) are actually unexplained.

[fixed 2026-10-21: decision_needed entry added; kept as other] LB 840 revolving-loan repayments are filed as 'other' with review. The Statement of Activities (p2) counts them as Economic Development operating grants and contributions. Repaid loan principal is arguably not revenue, so a person may want to decide how to treat it (not in decision_needed).
